title: 第二十章：她开始布局第二步
lines: 相府的“恐惧”，并没有让局停下来。
苏柔已经三天没有出院。
相反，这三天，她几乎没睡。
一个能把苏晚彻底按死的机会。
她坐在烛火前，手指慢慢划过一只小瓷瓶。
普通到像药房里随手可拿的清热散。
但里面的东西，却不是药。
这是她从外面高价买来的。
卖药的人只说了一句话：
“只让人，在最重要的场合，失去呼吸。”
她抬手，将瓷瓶递给丫鬟。
content_zh:
次日，天空终于放晴，阳光洒在侯府的每一个角落，然而整个侯府却弥漫着一种比暴雨那两日更为压抑的氛围。因为所有人都察觉到，大小姐变了。

    从前，遇到事情她会哭闹，会跑去求侯爷主持公道。可如今，她不再争闹，只是安静地待在听雨轩。这种反常的安静，反而让众人心中隐隐不安。

    此刻，听雨轩内一片忙碌景象。陈伯正有条不紊地整理账册，孙远拨弄着算盘，发出清脆的声响，柳姨专注地绣着一件月白色外衫，阿七则尽职地守在门口，俨然已经形成了一个小团体。

    沈知微坐在窗边，慢慢喝着药。高烧虽退了些许，但她的脸色依旧透着苍白。

    就在这时，青禾脚步匆匆地走进来。

    “姑娘，打听到了。”

    “什么情况？”

    “二姑娘这几日一直在偷偷试宫宴的衣裳，苏氏还特意请了从宫里出来的教习嬷嬷教她礼仪。”

    “轰” 的一下，春桃顿时气得火冒三丈。

    “太过分了！宫里的帖子明明是给姑娘您的，她们怎么敢如此明目张胆？”

    沈知微却只是微微一笑，说道：“为什么不敢？因为她们觉得，我还会像过去一样，只会生气，却毫无办法。”

    说着，她缓缓放下药碗。

    “青禾，替我去办一件事。”

    “姑娘请吩咐。”

    “把我病倒的消息传出去。”

    众人听闻，皆是一愣。春桃更是着急地说道：“姑娘，为什么要这么做呀？这样一来，她们岂不是会更加得意？”

    沈知微从容地笑了笑，说道：“就是要让她们得意。人只有在自以为赢了的时候，才最容易暴露出破绽。”
content_en:
The heavy rain raged all night, and there was still no sign of stopping until dawn.

    Outside the ancestral hall, the cold wind was biting and biting like a knife. Shen Zhiwei has been kneeling on this cold futon for two whole days. Her knees have been so numb that she has lost consciousness. Her face is as pale as paper, without a trace of blood, like a lifeless statue. However, she still held on tenaciously and did not fall. Because she knew in her heart that she must not show weakness at this moment. Once she fell, those people in the Hou Mansion with ulterior motives would definitely bully her even more.

    Ke Ren's body is not made of steel after all. As soon as he stood up, his eyes suddenly turned black and he stumbled involuntarily.

    "Girl!" Chuntao, with quick eyes and quick hands, hurriedly stepped forward to support her. As soon as his hand touched Shen Zhiwei's forehead, he exclaimed in fright: "It's so hot! Girl, you have a fever!"

    When Qinghe saw this, he was also panicked and said hurriedly: "I will go and ask for the doctor immediately."

    However, not long after she ran out, she came back with red eyes.

    "Girl... the doctor refuses to come."

    With a "boom", Chuntao's eyes turned red with anger, and she asked angrily: "Why?"

    Qing He bit her lip tightly and said with a hint of sob in her voice: "Madam said... The eldest lady is being punished, and no one is allowed to help without authorization."

    The air froze instantly, but Shen Zhiwei did not show the slightest surprise. This was Su's real method. He did not beat or scold her, but trapped her in a desperate situation bit by bit by cutting off all help.

    At this moment, there was a sound of footsteps at the door, and a woman slowly walked in carrying a bowl of porridge.

    "Miss, Madam feels sorry for you and specially asked the kitchen to bring it to you."

    Chuntao hurriedly took it, but the next second, her face turned extremely ugly. The porridge in the bowl was so thin that you could almost see the figure, and it was already cold, with a few grains of broken rice floating on it.

    With a "boom", Qinghe was so angry that he trembled all over and said angrily: "How can this be food for people? Even the servants can eat better than this!"

    But the mother-in-law just sneered and said, "The eldest lady is being punished. She is already doing well if she stutters." After saying that, she turned around and walked away.

    Chuntao was so angry that tears came out of her eyes, and she cried: "Girl, they are really bullying others! I will go to the Marquis to judge!"

    But Shen Zhiwei slowly shook his head and said, "I won't go."

    Chuntao was stunned and asked with confusion: "Why?"

    Shen Zhiwei looked gently at the bowl of cold porridge, suddenly smiled slightly, and said, "Because, she finally started to get anxious."
title_en: Chapter 19: The humiliation of a bowl of cold porridge
